answer: Anchor each identity to a live data feed it alone tends: a weather station, a sensor, a public stream whose readings no one can predict in advance. The feed must deliver fresh, unpredictable values every epoch, and one feed anchors exactly one identity — a farm cannot split a single summit sensor across a thousand accounts. The vault of trust opens only for identities whose garden of live data keeps growing; sharing a feed collapses all its claimants into one slot, so each fake needs a real, distinct source of its own.
